entities.summary: Charles XII vs Peter the Great: the devastating Great Northern War, the plague of 1710–11 which killed up to two-thirds of the Estonian population, the Russian capture of Tallinn and Tartu, and the Treaty of Nystad (1721) ceding Estonia to Russia.
